newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent rangebound pre US stats, gas oil slips.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent rangebound pre US stats, gas oil slips.

text.p: IPE Brent futures stayed rangebound at slightly higher levels on Tuesday afternoon as markets marked time ahead of the weekly release of U.S. inventory statistics.
December Brent stood up 12 cents at $22.40 a barrel at 1550 GMT, near the top of a narrow 20 cent range for the day so far.
But IPE gas oil for November lost more ground as European physical diesel markets came under heavy pressure from the arrival of U.S. and Algerian cargoes.
"There's a feeling gas oil could test lower ahead of the close, but people may wait to see what the APIs do," said a broker.
Dealers were expecting a repeat of last week's build in heating oil inventories in the U.S. where refineries have been pumping record volumes in recent weeks.
Gas oil's premium over Brent slipped further to $4.82 a barrel for December contracts.
Markets shrugged off news of a successful seven-hour heart surgery operation on Russian President Boris Yeltsin.
In the U.S. gasoline again was lending support while heating oil was weighing on the market.
